evaluation.name: Portable Unity 6.5 hybrid direct and iterative physics

qa_pair.question: How do I discover the hybrid solver boundary?
qa_pair.answer: Call get_hybrid_physics_capabilities. It reports supported stiff-joint rows, gear limits, the no-work fast path, shared editor/export runtime, native Babylon/Havok iterative collision ownership, and explicit Unity Physics/Burst/ECS non-claims.

qa_pair.question: How do I inspect current solver settings and evidence?
qa_pair.answer: Call get_hybrid_physics_solver. It returns the exact revision, bounded settings, gear couplings, owned Chain and Gears samples, processed/skipped frame counts, rows, residuals, and timing without advancing physics.

qa_pair.question: How do I configure the direct solver safely?
qa_pair.answer: Call set_hybrid_physics_solver with the latest expectedRevision and at least one bounded field. The normal Scene Inspector shares the owner and the change supports Undo and Redo.

qa_pair.question: When does direct-solver processing run?
qa_pair.answer: Only when an enabled direct joint or gear coupling produces a row. get_hybrid_physics_runtime reports skipped frames and the exact reason when no row requires work.

qa_pair.question: How are direct rows coupled to collision simulation?
qa_pair.answer: Babylon and Havok first perform the ordinary iterative contact and joint pass. One bounded globally coupled pivoted linear impulse solve then corrects selected stiff rows against the velocities produced by that native pass.

qa_pair.question: How do I mark a joint as stiff?
qa_pair.answer: Call set_physics_constraint_solver with the joint id, exact per-constraint revision, and solverMode direct. Ball, distance, hinge, and lock are supported; other native constraint families remain iterative.

qa_pair.question: How do I couple two rotating bodies as gears?
qa_pair.answer: Call create_hybrid_physics_gear_coupling with the exact solver revision, two physics mesh ids, normalized local axes, a nonzero signed ratio, optional target velocity, and bounded impulse cap.

qa_pair.question: Can I test direct rows without advancing the whole game?
qa_pair.answer: Call solve_hybrid_physics_now with the exact configuration revision and optional fixed delta. It applies one supplemental velocity solve while explicitly not stepping Havok, collision detection, scripts, cloth, or Physics 2D.

qa_pair.question: How do I create the Chain and Gears sample?
qa_pair.answer: Call create_chain_gears_physics_sample with the exact solver revision. It creates 12 through 32 dynamic chain links, two hinged gears, direct stiff-link rows, a gear coupling, native iterative contacts, explicit ownership, and rollback on failure.

qa_pair.question: How do I clean up a generated sample?
qa_pair.answer: Call delete_chain_gears_physics_sample with its exact sample revision, current solver revision, and confirm true. It removes only owned nodes, constraints, coupling, and now-unused materials.
